cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo)

file(GLOB PHYSX_COMMON_SOURCE 
	physx/source/*.cpp
	physx/source/common/*.cpp
	physx/source/common/src/*.cpp
	physx/source/fastxml/*.cpp

	physx/source/physxvehicle/src/*.cpp
	physx/source/physxvehicle/src/physxmetadata/*.cpp
	physx/source/physxvehicle/src/physxmetadata/src/*.cpp
	physx/source/pvd/*.cpp

	physx/source/simulationcontroller/src/*.cpp

if(WIN32)
	file(GLOB PHYSX_PLATFORM_SOURCE 
		physx/source/common/src/windows/*.cpp
		physx/source/foundation/src/windows/*.cpp
		physx/source/physx/src/device/windows/*.cpp
		physx/source/physx/src/windows/*.cpp
		physx/source/physxcooking/src/windows/*.cpp
	)
else()
	file(GLOB PHYSX_PLATFORM_SOURCE
		physx/source/foundation/src/unix/*.cpp
		physx/source/physx/src/device/linux/*.cpp)
endif()

add_library(physx STATIC ${PHYSX_COMMON_SOURCE} ${PHYSX_PLATFORM_SOURCE})

target_compile_definitions(physx PRIVATE PX_COOKING PX_PHYSX_STATIC_LIB)

if(NOT WIN32)
	target_compile_definitions(physx PRIVATE NDEBUG)
endif()

if(EMSCRIPTEN)
	target_compile_definitions(physx PRIVATE PX_SIMD_DISABLED)
endif()
